sp.headline: We don't just build software — we build the strategy behind it
sp.subheadline: From business analysis to working product. Finance-driven strategy, AI-powered execution, measurable results.
sp.phil_desc: Most agencies want to become another monthly bill. We don't. If your problem is solved with a tool that runs locally — that's what we build, and we're done. No subscriptions, no artificial dependency.
sp.phil_lockin_desc: You own everything we build. Full code, full access, no proprietary traps. Walk away whenever you want — with everything in hand.
sp.phil_pay_title: Pay Only for What You Need
sp.phil_pay_desc: A simple landing page? Starting at €600 and done. Complex system that needs ongoing support? We scale together. You decide.
sp.phil_honest_desc: If you don't need us, we'll tell you. We'd rather earn your trust than your subscription. That's how we get referrals.
sp.star_desc: A professional, SEO-optimized website with a built-in editor so simple that if you can post a story, you can update your site. Change text, swap images, add services — all from your phone or laptop.
sp.star_f1: Edit your site as easily as posting on Instagram — no code, no developer
sp.star_f2: Multilingual — your site in 2-3 languages, one click to switch
sp.star_f3: SEO-optimized from day one — show up when people search for you
sp.star_f4: Lightning-fast — built with the same tech as Vercel and Stripe
sp.star_f5: You own it. No subscriptions. No lock-in.
sp.star_demo_sub: Edit your website in real time
sp.star_demo_field2: Write your description and see it update live on your website...
sp.step1_desc: 30 minutes. Tell us about your business. We'll tell you honestly if and how we can help — no sales pitch.
sp.step2_desc: We analyze your operation and deliver a clear roadmap with projected impact, timeline, and real costs.
sp.step3_desc: We build in 1-2 week sprints. You see progress and give feedback continuously — no surprises at the end.
sp.step4_desc: We launch, track results, and optimize. You get real numbers, not promises.
sp.svc_consulting_desc: Most agencies start with code. We start with your P&L. Our team combines finance, data science, and AI strategy with deep systems engineering — so we don't just identify the opportunity, we know exactly how to build it.
sp.svc_consulting_b1: Find your highest-ROI opportunity before writing a single line of code
sp.svc_consulting_b2: Get a clear roadmap with projected impact, timeline, and real costs
sp.svc_consulting_b3: Strategy backed by data and built by engineers — not slide decks that collect dust
sp.svc_auto_desc: Your team spends hours on repetitive tasks that software can do in seconds. We find those bottlenecks, build the automation, and give you back your time.
sp.svc_auto_b2: Connect your existing tools — no need to replace what works
sp.svc_auto_b3: Custom dashboards so you see everything in one place
sp.svc_apps_desc: When your business outgrows spreadsheets and off-the-shelf tools, you need something built for the way you work. We design and build custom platforms that fit your operation — not the other way around.
sp.svc_apps_b1: Go live on web and mobile simultaneously — reach customers everywhere
sp.svc_apps_b2: Built to grow with you — no rebuilding when you scale
sp.svc_apps_b3: Your data, your platform, your rules
sp.svc_apps_visual: From CRMs to client portals to internal tools — we build what your business actually needs.
sp.t_cubiko_text: CaliDev helped us design a product strategy using Google's API to analyze Meta Ads performance — predicting which ads would succeed before spending the budget. The product showed so much potential that we were acquired by Dropi, one of Colombia's largest e-commerce conglomerates.
sp.t_cubiko_role: CEO, Cubiko Colombia → acquired by Dropi
sp.t_limpia_short_text: Victor didn't just build us a tool — he analyzed our entire operation, found where we were losing money, and built a CRM that gave us 27 hours back every week.
sp.results_sub: Not hypothetical case studies. These are businesses we've worked with and the outcomes they achieved.
sp.t_limpia_text: Before CaliDev, we managed everything in spreadsheets — payroll, bookings, client data. Victor didn't just build us an app. He analyzed our entire operation, found where we were losing money, and built a CRM that gave us 27 hours back every week. Our profits grew 37%, we went from 12 to 19 employees, expanded to a second city, and we're projecting 6 cities by 2027.
